column1: # winport-hooks (docs/re-winport.md 7.8): the Windows-only SITEs of the redesigns (no Linux site: their SITE() lines are
# under #ifdef _WIN32 with zero Linux values). RVAs on the Steam-Windows exe (sha256 f5d72578...).

column10: Combat_LogPrintf (winport-world 7.4: 363 callers, Linux 0x2751a50 361) is the empty stub `mov [rsp+0x18],r8; mov [rsp+0x20],r9; ret`: an entry hook (MinHook) with our own varargs formatter (prefix rcx, fmt rdx, ...) replaces Linux's BR_NODELOG sink write; SOMVR_VERBS_BRAND_NODELOG only (a test switch)

build 42 (som-b42-archers, re-xr-pipeline.md 185): the shipped game's shared `xor al,al; ret` + int3 padding (every folded "return false"; 164 direct calls); the attack log's gate in FUN_1408c9930 / FUN_1408ccdc0 is `cmp byte [0x141989ec9],0; je; mov rcx,[self]; call 0x140c00cb0 (mov rax,[rcx+0x4a0]); mov rcx,rax; call 0x14100ff70; test al,al; je` - an entry hook (MinHook: 3 bytes + padding) that answers 1 only inside the node-log window for a return address in 0x1408c9930..0x1408cd410 whose bytes are that gate; 0 for every other caller as before. SOMVR_VERBS_BRAND_NODELOG only (a test switch)

build 42: the attack predicates (Linux SharedCombat_AttackPredicates FUN_02258db0; "%s: Rejected Attack: %s - <test>", ~100 tests): (cache rcx = the attack's predicate cache, attack rdx, ctx r8 ([r8] = self), target r9 or 0 -> al); 2 callers, both in SharedCombat_SelectAttackFromPool 0x1408ccdc0. An entry hook logs a brand attack's answer while the node-log window is open; SOMVR_VERBS_BRAND_NODELOG only

OB_RANGE's first inlined call in the marker update 0x1404e6770 (0x1404e6a04: rcx = *(m+0x298), the record; NULL-safe): the record's kind bits (schema *0x14183b550 +0x558/+0x568 as Linux FUN_00ebced0's start), tested against *0x1418f4308 (OB_RANGE_MASK) at 0x1404e6a10
the marker update's call when (kind & mask) == 0 (0x1404e6a23): (ob_range_t *out rcx, rec rdx) -> out, {0, DAT_1416c0f8c} first, the schema's +0x528 range; NULL rec allowed
the call when (kind & mask) != 0 (0x1404e6a1c): the same shape, the schema's +0x588 range (Linux FUN_00ebced0's second branch +0x588/+0x598)

the FX create with the inlined wrappers' gate (DAT_1417fab60) - VG_FXC/VG_FXC1's one entry hook (66 call sites, winport-ui 7.6); the same 6 arguments as Linux's FUN_00d8bae0 (somvr_w_vbglow unchanged); CP_FX's call and FI_FX_CREATE's check name it too and start first

the tokens' setter (res rcx, v edx): skip if v == +0x50, clamp to [byte 0x141989ed3 ? 1 : 0, +0x4c] (Linux FUN_02720a90: [(u8)*0x4c44398, +0x4c]), store +0x50, the event 0x140ce2740 (if *(+0x30)+0x88), the HUD (+0x61 unlimited: 999); the game's spend 0x140cdb6b0 calls it with +0x50 - cost - BOW_TOKENS_ADD = it with +0x50 + delta

the records DB's schema registry: 1208 x `lea rax,[rip+schema]; mov [rcx+8k],rax` (48 8d 05 / 48 89 01|41|81) then ret; each schema object in .data: +0 the field array, +8 the count, +0x10 / +0x18 / +0x20 short name, description, full name (= Linux's holder layout); the schema checker (7.9) decodes it - read only, never called
